reviewSamples.author: Photo of Jessica Gasper
reviewSamples.text: We had a great experience with Jose and all of our custom closets in our new construction home. He was reasonably priced, worked with us on our design, understood the assignment and produced quality craftsmanship. He fixed a couple minor issues immediately to make sure we were 100% satisfied. We love our closets!!
